name: markdown-docs
about: A Markdown document (README.md) for your code: every relative link and #anchor resolves, every code name it puts in `inline code` exists in the code, and it mentions every name you list. Proves the references are real and the coverage complete, not that the explanations are right.
instructions: Reply with the Markdown document only. Put every code name (functions, types, constants) in `inline code` or code blocks, exactly as spelled in the code; names you make up for an example must be defined in that example. Link only to headings in this document (#anchors) or to web pages.

code.about: the code being documented (one file; concatenate several)

mention.about: comma-separated names the document must cover (e.g. the public API)
